annual.label: Annual Report 2026
annual.summary: The Indian economy is estimated to grow at 7.6% in FY 2025-26, up from 7.1% in FY 2024-25, as RBI rate cuts along with cuts in personal tax and GST led to recovery in consumption demand. Total India oil demand was at 243.2 MMT, growing 1.7% on a Y-o-Y basis, led by transportation fuels. Capex was principally directed towards growth projects in the O2C and New Energy business, along with continuing growth initiatives in Digital Services and Retail businesses.
highlights: The Indian economy is estimated to grow at 7.6% in FY 2025-26, up from 7.1% in FY 2024-25, as RBI rate cuts along with cuts in personal tax and GST led to recovery in consumption demand.
Total India oil demand was at 243.2 MMT, growing 1.7% on a Y-o-Y basis, led by transportation fuels.
Capex was principally directed towards growth projects in the O2C and New Energy business, along with continuing growth initiatives in Digital Services and Retail businesses.
Profitability for O2C business was driven by sharply improved margin environment for transportation fuels, offsetting subdued downstream petrochemical deltas.
